name: Zed
summary: Sends diagnostics (crash reports and debug info, via Sentry) and anonymized usage metrics by default. Server-side data is collected when using Zed's hosted AI or collaboration services.

optOut.instructions: In settings.json set "telemetry": {"diagnostics": false, "metrics": false}. Both must be false to stop all client-side telemetry, so this app does not check the state.
